raw_text: {"relevant_claims":["The counter-offer would fall below the standard 30% minimum once SPRING26 relief no longer applies.","SPRING26 is valid on 2026-05-20 and lowers the minimum margin by 4 points, to 26%.","Deal_desk approval is not required because monthly volume of $95,000 is below $4,000,000."],"evidence_ids":["PRC-2026.1§1","PRC-2026.1§2","PRC-2026.1§3","PRC-2026.1§4","PRC-2026.1§5","PRC-2026.1§6","PRC-2026.1§7","PRC-2026.1§8","FACT-profile","FACT-volume","FACT-transactions","FACT-cost","FACT-request","FACT-decision_date","FACT-exception"],"explanation":"No material claim is unsupported. Every claim traces to the evidence. Policy applicability follows from FACT-decision_date and PRC-2026.1§1. The small-merchant 30% minimum comes from FACT-profile and PRC-2026.1§3. SPRING26's 4-point relief to 26% follows from PRC-2026.1§6, because 2026-05-20 is within 04-01 to 06-30. Cost, revenue and margin figures follow by arithmetic from FACT-cost, FACT-volume, FACT-transactions and FACT-request. List revenue and the discount figures follow from PRC-2026.1§2 and §4. The approval routing applies the rules as written: regional_pricing_manager for a discount over 12% (§4), promotions_lead for any promotion use (§6), no deal_desk because $95,000 is not above $4,000,000 (§5), no pricing_desk because merchant cost data exists (FACT-cost, §8), and no strategic exception because the margin meets the floor (§3, §7). The merchant's request is correctly attributed as an unverified merchant statement. The closing remark is also supported: 26.26% is below the standard 30% in §3, and §6 limits relief to SPRING26's validity window.","uncertainty_reason":null,"failure_detected":false}
